# clean the data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

survey1 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey QAQC.xlsx", 
                      sheet = "Survey 1", col_types = "text")
survey1 <- survey1 %>% mutate(Survey = 1)
#survey1 <- survey1[-c(1, 2), ]
#survey1 <- survey1 %>%
#  select(19:58)
view(survey1)
summary(survey1)

survey2 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey QAQC.xlsx", 
                      sheet = "Survey 2", col_types = "text")
survey2 <- survey2 %>% mutate(Survey = 2)
view(survey2)

survey3 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey QAQC.xlsx", 
                      sheet = "Survey 3", col_types = "text")
survey3 <- survey3 %>% mutate(Survey = 3)
view(survey3)

survey4 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey QAQC.xlsx", 
                      sheet = "Survey 4", col_types = "text")
survey4 <- survey4 %>% mutate(Survey = 4)
view(survey4)


# Combine the datasets into one
all_surveys <- bind_rows(survey1, survey2, survey3, survey4)
view(all_surveys)
summary(all_surveys)
all_surveys$ID <- as.factor(all_surveys$ID)
all_surveys$Duration <- as.numeric(all_surveys$Duration)
summary(all_surveys)
```

# Count participants 
```{r}
master_list <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey_stats_QAQCed.xlsx", sheet = "Master Data", col_types = "text")
summary(master_list)
master_list$`Student ID` <- as.factor(master_list$`Student ID`)
# Count unique student IDs
unique_ids <- master_list %>%
  summarise(num_unique_ids = n_distinct(`Student ID`))
# Print the result
print(unique_ids) # 126 responses 

# clean 1 removed NA responses or students that only took 1/4 surveys
clean_1 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey_stats_QAQCed.xlsx", sheet = "2-4 surveys", col_types = "text")
summary(clean_1)
clean_1$`Student ID` <- as.factor(clean_1$`Student ID`)
# Count unique student IDs
unique_ids <- clean_1 %>%
  summarise(num_unique_ids = n_distinct(`Student ID`))
# Print the result
print(unique_ids) # 117 responses 

# clean 2 removed students who only answered 2 surveys and left only students that answered 3-4 surveys
clean_2 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey_stats_QAQCed.xlsx", sheet = "3 or 4 surveys", col_types = "text")
summary(clean_2)
clean_2$`Student ID` <- as.factor(clean_2$`Student ID`)
# Count unique student IDs
unique_ids <- clean_2 %>%
  summarise(num_unique_ids = n_distinct(`Student ID`))
# Print the result
print(unique_ids) # 108 responses 

# clean 3 removed any responses found during QAQC for short duration or uniform/sequential responses
clean_3 <- read_excel("/Users/alexgood/Desktop/Education Chapter/Survey_stats_QAQCed.xlsx", sheet = "outliers removed", col_types = "text")
summary(clean_3)
clean_3$`Student ID` <- as.factor(clean_3$`Student ID`)
# Count unique student IDs
unique_ids <- clean_3 %>%
  summarise(num_unique_ids = n_distinct(`Student ID`))
# Print the result
print(unique_ids) # 100 responses 
```

# Check for short duration 
```{r}
# Filter out rows where Duration is less than 90
all_surveys <- all_surveys %>%
  filter(Duration >= 90)

all_surveys <- all_surveys %>%
  filter(Duration > 90)

# View the cleaned data to confirm
View(all_surveys)

# View the filtered rows
View(filtered_duration)

# 19 responses 
```

# Uniform and Sequential responses
```{r}
#all_surveys <- all_surveys %>%
#  drop_na()

all_surveys %>%
  select(all_of(question_cols)) %>%
  summarise_all(~ sum(!is.numeric(.))) # Counts non-numeric values
          

# Calculate the standard deviation of responses for each participant per survey
uniform_responses <- all_surveys %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sd_responses = sd(c_across(-c(ID, Duration, Survey)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% # Exclude ID, Duration, and Survey
  filter(sd_responses == 0) # Keep only rows where the standard deviation is zero

# View uniform responses
uniform_responses
# remove 6 students 

# Ensure all response columns are numeric
all_surveys <- all_surveys %>%
  mutate(across(-c(ID, Duration, Survey), as.numeric))

# Identify sequential responses for each participant
sequential_responses <- all_surveys %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(is_sequential = all(diff(c_across(-c(ID, Duration, Survey)), na.rm = TRUE) == 1 |  # Check ascending sequence
                             diff(c_across(-c(ID, Duration, Survey)), na.rm = TRUE) == -1)) %>%  # Check descending sequence
  filter(is_sequential == TRUE) # Filter only sequential responses

# View sequential responses
sequential_responses # NONE 
```
